info.title: Independent LLM Gateway
info.description: Independent technical tenants, routing, metering and prepaid wallet settlement. Commercial identity, payments, subscriptions and marketing remain external. No LLM content persistence.

cost_atoms.description: Integer atoms, 10^-18 units of the recorded currency. Cumulative per-attempt evidence; never sum revisions.

parameters.name: x-gateway-currency
parameters.description: Wallet and tariff currency; defaults to project currency. No FX conversion.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Repeated intentions return 409 and their original request ID; Gateway cannot replay response bodies.

200.description: Success; output content is never retained by Gateway

402.description: Insufficient eligible funds or frozen wallet

404.description: Owned resource or model not found

409.description: Configuration/payload conflict or an already accepted intention

429.description: Rate, token or concurrency budget exceeded

502.description: Provider, conversion or usage finalization failed

schema.description: Native provider request. Logical model alias replaces the upstream model. Unsupported cross-protocol semantics return 422.
